scope: Bounded read-only source review of Chicago demo integration and native viewport/window input handling; not a runtime or GPU validation.

findings.issue: Starting Chicago Demo from Paris restored selected lighting only in WalkthroughPlayback, leaving the published controller lighting and render options at the load default.
findings.resolution: After restoring the selection and starting the demo, copy playback.lighting to the controller lighting property.
findings.verification: Confirmed assignment in the reviewed source; native Paris-to-Chicago loading and displayed lighting remain runtime smoke-test scope.

findings.issue: Escape cleared focus/help but removed the viewport first responder, conflicting with immediate keyboard navigation after focus release.
findings.resolution: Call engine.focusViewport() after clearing focus/help instead of removing the first responder.
findings.verification: Confirmed updated Escape handler in the reviewed source; actual AppKit event delivery remains native smoke-test scope.

reviewedBehavior: Automatic demo route/location transitions adopt playback.location directly, retaining the existing Chicago renderer and navigation world instead of invoking location selection and cancelling the demo.
Paris-to-Chicago loading pauses drawing, drains the previous GPU queue, generation-guards asynchronous completion and retains the queued demo state when applying the camera after load.
Space, explicit stop, manual exits and destination/view HUD synchronization follow the playback contract; stop holds the current route pose.
Titlebar movement and live resizing suspend camera/playback advancement and sceneSeconds together; the resume path resets previousTime to avoid elapsed-time catch-up.
Escape retains the viewport responder after clearing focus; help cancels active pointer ownership and held movement keys.
limits: Source review only: no tests, application build, GPU jobs or native UI operations were performed during this review.
The passed field means no remaining substantive findings within this bounded code-review scope, not certification of runtime behavior or the entire release.
Native titlebar tracking, live resize, responder delivery and asynchronous loading should be verified in the separate release smoke checks.
The listed hashes identify the exact reviewed revisions; later source changes require separate evidence.
